title: pnpm Workspace Monorepo Plan
description: A structured plan for a pnpm-workspaces monorepo so scripts/pnpm_workspace_monorepo_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against this skill's Quality Gates.

internalDepProtocol.description: How sibling packages reference each other. Must be the workspace: protocol.

sharedVersionSource.description: Where shared dependency versions are pinned. per-package drifts and fails.

lockfileCommitted.description: True if pnpm-lock.yaml is committed to the repo.

ciFrozenLockfile.description: True if CI installs with --frozen-lockfile so lockfile changes fail the build.

missingPeerFix.description: How missing/broken peer deps are handled.

publishCommand.description: How packages are published. npm-publish leaks workspace:* ranges and fails.

turboInputsDeclared.description: True if turbo.json tasks declare inputs so the cache reflects real dependencies.

ciAffectedOnlyFilter.description: True if CI uses --filter "...[origin/main]" to build/test only affected packages.

usesTypescript.description: True if the workspace is TypeScript (enables the project-references check).

tsProjectReferencesMirrorGraph.description: True if tsconfig references mirror the workspace dependency graph for tsc -b.

postinstallAllowlist.description: True if pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies allowlists which deps may run lifecycle scripts.

enginesNodeSet.description: True if every package declares engines.node matching the repo Node version.
